display_information.name: Forge
display_information.description: Backend worker bot for gg-sandbox fleetmind test fleet - receives delegations from Conductor.
display_information.long_description: Forge is the backend specialty worker bot for Grace's gg-sandbox test fleet (Continuous-Agentics/fleetmind). It receives task envelopes from Conductor (the PM bot), acknowledges with :eyes:, ships work back through a DynamoDB task ledger, and posts completion summaries. Runs on dedicated EC2 in AWS account 251714435910 (us-west-2).
